title: K-flatness of the actual completed exterior Koszul complexes
statement: Let T be a scheme, A a commutative ring and d an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. For any finite sequence a in A and natural m, the actual completed exterior Koszul complex completedAdicKoszul(T,d,a,m) of [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion] is K-flat for the sheaf tensor product. No regularity hypothesis on a is needed; the empty sequence and the zero ring are included.

source.place: Tag 06YQ (bounded above complexes of flat modules); Tag 0G7E (change of rings for K-flat complexes)

proof.text: The constant module-sheaf functor is additive. Its sheafification Hom equivalence and the module-unit/global-sections equivalence show that the specified map from the unit to the constant rank-one module is an isomorphism. The exterior-power basis identifies each exterior Koszul term with a finite coproduct of that unit. This includes exterior degrees exceeding the rank, where the coproduct is empty.

Tensoring by a finite coproduct of units is exact. Prove this by the tensor-colimit comparison, pointwise exactness in the functor category and exact finite coproducts in the Grothendieck module category. The reindexed Koszul complex vanishes in positive cochain degrees, and every remaining term is one of these finite free sheaves. The bounded-above flat criterion proves K-flatness of the constant Koszul complex.

Apply the change-of-rings K-flat theorem to the constant complex and its flat terms. The object and morphism equations of completedAdicScalarExtensionData give a componentwise complex isomorphism from the recorded completed Koszul complex to that changed complex. Tensor this isomorphism with each acyclic complex and transport vanishing homology.
